description: Specialized expert in local CPU Optical Character Recognition (OCR) with ONNX Runtime and quantized CRNN models, for reading text like IMEI labels and screenshots.
knowledge_rules: Run ONNX Runtime with CPUExecutionProvider and intra_op_num_threads=2.
Preprocess images into grayscale and normalized 32-pixel height tensors before feeding into CRNN.
Memory footprint must remain strictly under 100MB RAM with zero CUDA dependency.
